name: Botsauto munt of jeton of penning (bumper car coin)

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a circular bumper car coin or token. It features a wide, thin outer disc ('pancake') with a smaller, thicker concentric ring positioned on one of its faces. This ring has a central circular hole, creating a recessed profile in the middle of the token.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric bumper car coin token in OpenSCAD. The design should consist of a wide central disc ('pancake') and a concentric ring with a central hole, allowing customization of the coin diameter, ring outer/inner diameters, disc thickness, and total thickness.
captions.factory: The code uses a 'union' operation to combine the two main components. The first component is a ring created by applying a 'difference' on two concentric 'cylinder' primitives using the outer ring diameter (B) and inner ring diameter (C) with the total thickness (E). The second component is the outer disc, created using a 'cylinder' with the coin diameter (A) and disc thickness (D), translated along the Z-axis by half of the total thickness (E/2).
